events.title: Godfather to Friedrich (Frederick) Meier
events.description: 'Joseph Wenz, Schuster von hier' was godfather at the baptism of Maria Anna Birkenmaier's son Friedrich. [R4-S1]

events.title: Wife godmother to Christina Mayer
events.description: His wife M. Anna Mayer, 'Ehefrau des Joseph Wenz, Bürger und Schuster von hier', was godmother. [R4-S2]

bio: Joseph Wenz, born in 1828, was a shoemaker and a citizen of Munzingen in Baden. He married Maria Anna Creszentia Mayer, the eldest sister of John's ancestor Friedrich Mayer. The two families stayed close: Joseph stood as godfather to Friedrich's first son, Friedrich (later Frederick Meier), in January 1862, and his wife was godmother to Pauline Mayer's daughter Christina in May 1864.
sources: [R4-S1] Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1591 (Munzingen, kath.), Geburtsbuch 1862 No. 2 (images 431–432) (primary) http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480947-431
[R4-S2] Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1591 (Munzingen, kath.), Geburtsbuch 1864 No. 9 (image 471) (primary) http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480947-471
researchNotes: Joseph Wenz, a shoemaker and citizen of Munzingen, was married to Friedrich Mayer's eldest sister Maria Anna Creszentia. He was godfather to Friedrich's first son in January 1862 ([R4-S1]), and his wife was godmother to Pauline Mayer's daughter Christina in 1864 ([R4-S2]).
summary: Shoemaker and citizen of Munzingen, husband of the eldest sister of John's ancestor Friedrich Mayer and godfather to Friedrich's first son.
